shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- next config ---\\n' && cat next.config.ts && printf '\\n--- tsconfig ---\\n' && cat tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- sources ---\\n' && for f in pages/404.js pages/_app.js pages/_document.js pages/_error.js pages/index.js pages/blog/index.js 'pages/blog/[id].js' pages/api/posts/index.js 'pages/api/posts/[id].js' components/AppProvider.js styles/globals.css; do printf '\\n### %s\\n' \""'$f"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "find pages -type f -o -type d 2>/dev/null | sort; rg -n \"next/head|next/router|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|next/document|pages/|useRouter\" --glob '"'!package-lock.json'"' .; rg --files app components lib | sort; git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- package.json package-lock.json; git status --short; rmdir pages/api/posts pages/api pages/blog pages'

/bin/bash -lc 'rg -n "not-found.*metadata|Metadata in .*not-found|not-found" node_modules/next/dist/docs node_modules/next 2>/dev/null | head -60; find . -maxdepth 2 -type d -name pages -print; git diff --stat'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '100,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/error.md; rg -n \"next/font|font CSS|does not work in app\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-components/font.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/components/font.md 2>/dev/null | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff -- tsconfig.json styles/globals.css && git diff --check && rg -n \"next/head|next/router|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|next/document\" --glob '"'!package-lock.json'"' --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' --glob '"'!.next/**'"' .; test "'! -d pages && echo '"'pages directory removed';"

/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check; git status --short; git diff --stat; rg --files app components lib | sort; rg -n "next/head|next/router|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|next/document" app components lib || true; test ! -d pages && echo '"'pages directory removed'"
